hero-h1: Banking technology built for institutions that put their members first.
hero-copy: PAXISS is a purpose-built core banking system for co-operative financial institutions and banks. Fully customisable and locally supported, PAXISS is developed and maintained by a Pretoria-based team with more than 40 years of experience in financial and related systems.
feat-h2: Comprehensive functionality. Purpose-built for co-operative banking.
feat-copy: PAXISS brings together the core banking functionality required by regulated co-operative financial institutions and banks in a single integrated platform, enabling your team to manage day-to-day banking operations efficiently, securely, and with confidence.
feat-cb-1-body: Capture and maintain comprehensive client profiles, including personal and contact details, identification records, relationships with related parties, and all relevant regulatory and compliance information.
feat-cb-2-body: Open, maintain, and manage accounts for all product types offered by the institution. Account functionality is driven by product definitions and client eligibility criteria.
feat-cb-3-body: A comprehensive transaction management system supporting deposits, withdrawals, transfers, payments, and fund transfers to external financial institutions. It also supports transactions between general ledger accounts, as well as suspended ('pending'), deferred, scheduled, and automated transactions.
feat-cb-4-body: Automated recurring client transactions executed according to predefined schedules. Standing instructions may continue indefinitely or terminate automatically once specified end conditions are met.
feat-cb-5-body: Manage and control cash holdings issued from the treasury to tellers and other authorised officials. Track cash balances by denomination, record all cash movements, and support end-of-day balancing and reconciliation. Multiple teller positions are supported, including full control and tracking of cash transfers between tellers and the treasury.
feat-pp-1-body: A flexible, user-definable product configuration facility that enables the institution to create, configure, and maintain financial products tailored to its specific requirements across multiple product classes, including savings, loans, investments, and transactional accounts.
feat-pp-2-body: Interest structures are dynamically configurable for each product. Define and maintain interest calculation methods, rates, structures, and related parameters, enabling the system to automatically calculate and apply interest in accordance with product-specific rules.
feat-pp-3-body: Fees are fully user-definable, enabling authorised officials to configure fee structures, rates, and the rules governing their application. The system automatically calculates and applies the appropriate fees in accordance with the defined rules.
feat-fm-1-body: A fully integrated general ledger automatically records all accounting entries arising from transactions, ensuring financial integrity, accurate account balances, and up-to-date financial reporting.
feat-fm-2-body: Authorised and duly mandated officials can perform controlled financial transactions directly between general ledger accounts, with appropriate controls and audit trails to support operational and administrative financial activities.
feat-sr-1-body: Manage member shareholdings throughout their lifecycle, including the issuance, maintenance, transfer, and redemption of shares. The system also supports the generation, printing, and management of share certificates.
feat-sr-2-body: Capture and maintain relationships between clients, accounts, and related parties, including representatives, signatories, trustees, beneficiaries, and guardians. The system automatically applies and enforces all relevant compliance and regulatory requirements applicable to each related party.
feat-sr-3-body: Capture and manage third-party sureties and collateral pledged as security for loans, including the registration and maintenance of ceded accounts, monitoring of pledged values, and enforcement of associated account restrictions.
feat-cr-1-body: Comprehensive FICA compliance management across all profiles, including clients and related parties. FICA-related information and supporting documentation are securely maintained electronically within the system to support compliance, verification, ongoing monitoring, and audit requirements.
feat-cr-2-body: Supports the data capture, validation, reporting, and submission processes required to comply with the regulatory requirements of the South African Corporation for Deposit Insurance (CODI).
feat-cr-3-body: Ensures the comprehensive capture and maintenance of all information required to meet applicable regulatory, governance, and compliance obligations.
feat-dr-1-body: Integrated document management for the secure storage and management of client-, account-, and transaction-related documents, including contracts, wills, trust deeds, identification documents, share certificates, surety and security documentation, and other supporting records directly within the system.
feat-sc-1-body: Role-based security enables administrators to define and control user access to system functions, data, and transactions according to assigned roles, responsibilities, and levels of authority.
feat-sc-2-body: Enables authorised officials to temporarily delegate specified access rights, authorities, and responsibilities to other officials for defined periods, subject to appropriate controls and a complete audit trail.
feat-sc-3-body: Comprehensive audit and forensic tracking records all user activities, transactions, approvals, amendments, and system access. A complete and tamper-resistant audit trail identifies who performed each action, when it occurred, and the workstation or facility from which it was performed.
feat-sc-4-body: Provides comprehensive visibility into user activity, system usage, transaction history, and operational events, supporting effective governance, management oversight, compliance, and risk management.
feat-ml-1-body: Seamlessly switch the system between English and Afrikaans, with all screens, menus, messages, and reports automatically displayed in the selected language. The system architecture also allows for additional languages to be supported where required.
feat-ben-2: Fully integrated accounting and general ledger
feat-ben-3: Flexible, user-definable products, fees, and interest structures
feat-ben-4: Built-in FICA and CODI compliance support
feat-ben-8: Flexible client and related-party relationship management
feat-ben-9: Member shareholding and share certificate management
feat-ben-12: Secure, role-based access and authority control
feat-ben-13: Real-time transaction processing and financial posting
feat-ben-14: Bilingual English/Afrikaans operation with support for additional languages
who-h2: Purpose-built for cooperative and community-based financial institutions in South Africa.
who-c1-body: CFIs requiring a comprehensive platform for member management, accounts, transactions, compliance, reporting, and day-to-day financial operations.
who-c2-body: Registered co-operative banks requiring a comprehensive core banking platform designed around the operational, governance, and regulatory requirements of the sector.
who-c3-body: Community-based credit unions seeking to formalise, strengthen, and streamline their operations while retaining the member-focused character that defines them.
who-c4-body: Savings groups and stokvel organisations seeking greater structure, transparency, financial control, and accountability as their operations grow and become more formalised.
who-int-body: While PAXISS is purpose-built for the South African cooperative banking environment, its flexible architecture allows the system to be customised for financial institutions in other countries. Regulatory requirements, reporting, products, workflows, languages, and other country-specific requirements can be adapted to suit the local operating environment.
who-cta-title: Not sure where your institution fits?
who-cta-body: Talk to us about your organisation, its requirements, and where it is heading. We can explore whether PAXISS is suited to your needs and how it could support your operations.
ide-h2: 40 years of experience in financial and related systems. PAXISS is built on that knowledge.
ide-p1: The team behind IDE Systems brings more than 40 years of experience in the development and implementation of financial and related systems, including solutions for major South African commercial banks. This extensive experience has shaped our understanding of the reliability, control, security, compliance, and accountability required of mission-critical financial systems.
ide-sub1-p: PAXISS was developed specifically for the needs of South African co-operative financial institutions and banks. It is not a repurposed commercial banking platform or an adapted foreign system. Its design reflects the operational, governance, regulatory, and member-focused requirements of the cooperative financial sector.
ide-sub2-h: Built around the South African regulatory environment
ide-sub2-p: As a Pretoria-based team, we work within the South African banking and regulatory environment. PAXISS has been designed with the Co-operative Banks Act, applicable prudential requirements, FICA, CODI requirements, and other relevant regulatory and compliance obligations in mind.
ide-sub3-p: No two financial institutions operate in exactly the same way. PAXISS can be configured and customised to accommodate an institution's products, operating procedures, governance structures, approval processes, and member requirements.
ide-sub4-p: PAXISS is developed and supported in South Africa by the same team that understands and works with the system. Our clients deal directly with people who understand both the technology and the local banking environment.
ide-sub5-p: Every institution is different. Talk to us about your organisation, its current systems, regulatory requirements, and future plans. We can explore how PAXISS could be configured to support your requirements.
dep-infra: PAXISS provides the same core banking functionality whether deployed in a managed cloud environment or on your institution's own infrastructure. Choose the deployment model that best suits your operational, security, regulatory, and IT requirements.
dep-mch: PAXISS can be hosted in a managed cloud environment, with infrastructure, system updates, backups, security maintenance, and availability monitoring managed on your behalf.
dep-mch-li5: Well suited to institutions with limited internal IT capacity
dep-opi: PAXISS can be deployed on your institution's own servers or private infrastructure, providing greater control over the data environment, system access, infrastructure, and integration architecture.
dep-opi-li1: Full control over your data environment and infrastructure
dep-opi-li2: Greater flexibility for integration with internal systems
dep-opi-li3: Suitable for institutions with established IT infrastructure
dep-opi-li4: Supports institution-specific security and infrastructure policies
dep-sup: IDE Systems provides implementation, configuration, migration, training, and ongoing technical support for both deployment models.
plat-mls: English and Afrikaans are supported throughout the system, with the architecture allowing for additional languages where required.
plat-int: PAXISS supports potential integration with external systems, services, reporting platforms, and other authorised data interfaces according to institutional requirements.
plat-arc: Access can be configured according to the institution's chosen deployment environment, infrastructure, security policies, and operational requirements.
faq-h2: Questions worth asking when considering a new core banking system.
faq-q1: Is PAXISS designed to support Prudential Authority and Co-operative Banks Act requirements?
faq-a1: Yes. PAXISS is purpose-built for the South African cooperative financial sector and is designed to support the regulatory and prudential requirements applicable to co-operative financial institutions and co-operative banks. The system incorporates comprehensive regulatory data management, FICA compliance functionality, audit and forensic tracking, and regulatory reporting capabilities. CODI reporting functionality is available for institutions to which CODI requirements apply.
faq-q2: Can PAXISS be deployed on our own servers, or is it only available as a cloud service?
faq-a2: Both options are available. PAXISS can be deployed in a managed cloud environment or installed on your institution's own infrastructure. The appropriate model depends on factors such as internal IT capacity, security requirements, data governance, integration requirements, and operational preferences. IDE Systems can assist your institution in determining the most appropriate deployment model.
faq-q3: How long does implementation take, and what support is provided?
faq-a3: Implementation timelines depend on the size and complexity of the institution, existing systems and data, required functionality, integrations, and the extent of configuration or customisation required. IDE Systems provides hands-on support throughout the implementation process, including system configuration, data migration, testing, staff training, go-live assistance, and ongoing post-implementation support.
faq-q4: Can PAXISS be customised to our institution's products and operating procedures?
faq-a4: Yes. Flexibility and customisation are fundamental to the PAXISS architecture. Products, interest structures, fees, workflows, approval processes, user authorities, and many other operational rules can be configured to meet institution-specific requirements. Where configuration alone is insufficient, additional customisation can be incorporated as part of the implementation.
faq-a5: PAXISS supports both English and Afrikaans throughout the system, including screens, menus, messages, and reports. The system architecture also allows for additional languages to be supported where required.
faq-q6: Can PAXISS be accessed remotely from branches or other locations?
faq-a6: PAXISS can be accessed remotely using Citrix remote access technology, enabling authorised staff, including those at rural or remote locations, to securely access the system from virtually any internet-connected device.
faq-q7: How does PAXISS support FICA compliance?
faq-a7: FICA-related functionality is integrated into client and related-party profile management and day-to-day operational processes. The system supports the capture and maintenance of identification and verification information, related compliance data, supporting documentation, and information required for ongoing compliance processes. This allows FICA-related information to form part of the client record rather than being maintained as a disconnected administrative process.
faq-q8: How does PAXISS support CODI reporting?
faq-a8: For institutions subject to CODI requirements, PAXISS supports the capture, validation, processing, and reporting of the depositor and account information required for CODI submissions. The functionality is designed around CODI's Single Customer View (SCV), coverage, and reporting requirements and supports the preparation of the required monthly and quarterly submission data.
faq-q9: Can PAXISS be used by financial institutions outside South Africa?
faq-a9: Yes. While PAXISS is purpose-built around the South African cooperative banking environment, its flexible and highly customisable architecture allows it to be adapted for use in other countries. Country-specific regulatory requirements, reporting, products, workflows, languages, currencies, and operational processes can be configured or customised to meet the requirements of the local banking environment.
